text_block_list.name: Cafe Lady
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear...
To have only the medium spicy curry left over...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
!! ...Auntie!
I was just craving medium-spicy curry!

text_block_list.name: Cafe Lady
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my! You saved the day, Hero-san!
Eat your fill, okay~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Uuugh...
My t-tongue... it stings and burns sho bad!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
T-Thish... wash to help... shomeone...!
I... protec... the academy'sh peace...!

Biko Pegasus suffered from the lingering spiciness
in her mouth for quite a while...
